 Advertisement Updated: 12:18 PM CST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Iowa football vs. Purdue: How to watch the Hawkeyes' next game
 Updated: 12:18 PM CST Nov 10, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ IOWA CITY, Iowa — Iowa returns home after a big road win last week with its playoff hopes still intact.
 The Hawkeyes (7-2 overall, 4-2 in Big Ten play) host Purdue (3-6 overall, 2-4 in Big Ten play) with momentum after a pair of big wins over Wisconsin and Northwestern by a combined score of 54-10.
 Advertisement How to watch and stream Iowa football vs. Purdue
 When : 6:30 p.m. CT, Saturday, Nov. 14
 Where : Kinnick Stadium, Iowa City
 TV : NBC
 Livestream : Peacock
 Tickets for Iowa vs. Purdue football at Kinnick Stadium
 You can find tickets on the secondary market through SeatGeek . As of Tuesday, two tickets together were available for as low as $39 apiece.
 Iowa vs. Purdue football series history
 Purdue holds the all-time lead in this series, but the Hawkeyes have the edge lately.
 The Boilermakers have a 50-41-3 lead all-time, with most of that success coming from the 1960s through 1980. Since Kirk Ferentz was hired at Iowa before the 1999 season, his Hawkeyes hold a 13-8 lead, including two wins in a row.
 Last 10 games: 
 2023 : Iowa 20, Purdue 14
 2022 : Iowa 24, Purdue 3
 2021 : Purdue 24, Iowa 7
 2020 : Purdue 24, Iowa 20
 2019 : Iowa 26, Purdue 20
 2018 : Purdue 38, Iowa 36
 2017 : Purdue 24, Iowa 15
 2016 : Iowa 49, Purdue 35
 2015 : Iowa 40, Purdue 20
 2014 : Iowa 24, Purdue 10
 What to know about Purdue football
 Purdue is 3-6 in its second year under coach Barry Odom.
 The Boilermakers' offense has been solid, averaging 29.4 points per game and putting up big numbers against good teams. Purdue scored 36 points against Wake Forest (in double-overtime), 38 points at unbeaten UCLA and 41 in a win over Minnesota.
 Those haven't always resulted in wins, largely because the defense (32.3 points allowed per game) ranks in the bottom 15 nationally.
 Three Big Ten opponents in a row — Washington, Penn State and Maryland — have recorded 31 or more points and 5.0 or more yards per carry against Purdue.
